rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Discord API integration server built by SaseQ using TypeScript and the MCP SDK, providing 80+ tools for complete Discord bot automation including server management, channel operations, message handling, role management, member administration, voice/audio control, event scheduling, and automod configuration. Features comprehensive channel organization capabilities with privacy controls, bulk operations, and advanced positioning, plus specialized tools for webhooks, embeds, file uploads, and private messaging. Includes robust error handling, rate limiting, configurable action permissions, and Docker deployment support, making it suitable for Discord community management, automated moderation workflows, and AI assistants that need programmatic Discord server control.
